work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act condoles with Nicholas I on the cholera death of Grand Duke Constantine. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF8250; own dating clause LF8290–8293 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die primo septembris millesimo octin- gentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF8354 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
